heading_en: Exposures Guaranteed by Credit Guarantee Corporations, etc.
summary_ja: 信用保証協会等の保証付きエクスポージャーを十パーセント、国の財政措置がある経営安定関連保証（全額保証）等を零パーセントとし、これらの保証には第百条・第百五条を適用しない。
summary_en: Exposures guaranteed by credit guarantee corporations take 10%; fully guaranteed business-stability guarantees backed by government funding take 0%; Articles 100 and 105 do not apply to these guarantees.
paragraphs: Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 22 through the preceding Article, the risk weight of exposures guaranteed by credit guarantee corporations, etc. shall be 10%.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraph, the risk weight of exposures relating to business stability-related guarantees provided in Article 12 of the Small and Medium-sized Enterprise Credit Insurance Act (Act No. 264 of 1950) for specified small and medium-sized enterprises provided in Article 2, paragraph (5) of that Act (limited to those for which the full amount of the obligation is guaranteed by a credit guarantee corporation (meaning a credit guarantee corporation provided in Article 1, item (xxxvi)(i))), for which the State has taken the necessary fiscal measures relating to the guarantee, and other similar guarantees, shall be 0%.
The provisions of Article 100 and Article 105 shall not apply to the guarantees provided in the preceding two paragraphs.
